## Delivered against the row

- **Review fixes (2026-10-16):** the wrap-up toast's Undo is one op: `chat_op_reopen` (CV-12's live body, re-cut here) also takes back the decision that wrap-up made, in the same transaction (the wrapper, within the 10 s Undo window, a decision stamped with the wrap-up's own time; `chat_op_wrap_up` now uses one clock for both), never a decision marked before or by someone else, and writes no "took back a decision" line ("undid a wrap-up" says it). Marking answers a message you can't read the same as a missing one (P0002). The chain panel's decision label has "Unmark" for people who can post there. Wrap up's tick follows the conversation's link while the dialog is open, until you change it. An item with no conversation the reader can see sends no decisions request (the project overview's two slots share one conversations read: `useItemChatSlots`). `CHAT_COPY_VERSION` 2 (device copies pick up the decision columns).
- **Server (migration):** `chat_messages.decision_at / decision_by` (FK to the person, `ON DELETE SET NULL` like `pinned_by`; CHECK: only a message, never an event line, and no marker without a time); partial index `(channel_id, decision_at desc) where decision_at is not null and deleted_at is null` and one on `decision_by`. The Realtime publication has no column list, so the columns ride it as they are. `chat_op_mark_decision(message, on)`: reading the message, post rights in the conversation (`chat__can_post`), the plan (`chat_op__guard` via `chat_op__channel`), never archived, messages only, idempotent, activity `chat.decision {message_id, on}`, no notice. `chat_op_wrap_up` (from CV-12's live body): `p_mark_decision` now marks the settling reply (same post rule; logged once as `chat.decision`). `chat_decisions_for_item(type, id)`: conversations linked to the item (all their decisions) or carrying its "Mentioned in" link (decisions whose own text refers to it, read with `chat__body_refs`), only those the caller reads (`chat_can_read_channel`), for an item the caller can open (`perm_can_see_entity`), signed-in callers only; returns the message, its chain root, the conversation, a direct message's other people by name, the excerpt (`chat__excerpt`), 50 newest. Grants re-stated by name: the two ops and the read for `authenticated` + `service_role`, never anon / PUBLIC (asserted in the migration and the test).
- **Chat:** ⋯ → Mark as decision / Unmark decision (flag icon, `⇧D`, frame 5's place after Make a task); `⇧D` on a selected message (bare `d` still types into the composer, §16). The quiet "Decision" label under the message (`data-slot="message-decision"`). Details' Decisions (frame 4: flag, words, the day it was marked; a click opens it in context). History line "marked a decision" / "took back a decision". Wrap up's "Also mark as decision" tick, on by default in a linked channel (CH53); Undo of that wrap-up also takes back a decision it made.
- **Items:** `DecisionLines` (`src/features/chat/decisions.tsx`): "Decided with Mike · Oct 12: …" (direct message) / "Decided in acme · Oct 12: …" (channel), references in the words named for the reader. In the project overview's `chat.decisions` slot (`tasks-plan-view.tsx`) and in every item's Linked after its conversation lines (through `MentionedInLines`: task detail, the contact and company hubs, the entity hub). A click opens the message in its conversation (its chain beside it when it's a reply).

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **Marking needs post rights in the conversation only** · agent (orchestrator's rule) · a decision is a statement about the conversation · rejected: pin's extra "Manage any channel" path (an admin outside an announcement channel can't mark there).
- **Wrap up with the tick is refused as a whole when the wrapper can't post** (an admin wrapping in an announcement channel they don't manage); the app shows the tick only to people who can post · agent · the ops decide, the menu doesn't offer what they refuse · rejected: silently skipping the mark.
- **A workspace member may mark in a public channel they haven't joined** · agent · same rule as pinning (`chat__can_post`); they can read and post there.
- **Any poster may unmark anyone's decision** · agent · §12 gives the verb to members, not authors · rejected: only the marker.
- **No pace limit on marking** · agent · it writes no event lines (the brief's note is about ops that do), toggling is idempotent and each change is one attributed history row like pin · rejected: a PT429 counter.
- **A decision on a deleted message stays stored but hidden everywhere**; restoring brings it back; a deleted message can't be unmarked · agent · delete has an Undo · rejected: clearing it on delete.
- **On an item: every decision of a linked channel; from a mentioning conversation only decisions whose own text refers to the item** · agent (brief's rule) · rejected: every decision of any mentioning conversation.
- **"Decided with …" names a direct message's other current members** ("with Ana, Mike and 2 others"); a channel reads "Decided in acme" (CH13's wording) · agent · §8 shows only the DM form.
- **The label is a quiet line under the message** (flag + "Decision", like "Became a task"), not a chip in the name row · agent · the frames don't draw it; under the body it reads with the message and survives grouped rows (no header).
- **Undo of a wrap-up also takes back the decision that wrap-up made** (not one marked earlier), in the same op as the reopen, with no "took back" line · agent (orchestrator's call after review) · Undo should leave things as they were, and a failure can't leave half of it · rejected: a second call from the toast.
- **A decision follows a moved message** (CV-16 moves the row and leaves `decision_at/by`; its mentions re-link from where it went), and the move's Undo brings it back · agent.
- **⇧D works only in the stream; the chain panel has no message menu yet**, so a reply is marked from the stream or by Wrap up's tick, and unmarked in the chain by "Unmark" beside its label · agent.
- **Wrap up's tick defaults to the conversation's link and follows it while the dialog is open until you touch it** · agent (code review) · rejected: reading it once on open.
- **No "Decided" line in Catch up or the bell** · spec: quiet, no notice.

## Gotchas (area: supabase)

- A mention links only an item in `entities`: a test that inserts a bucket directly must register it, or its "Mentioned in" (and decision) lines never appear.
- Deploy: the CHECK on `chat_messages` and the two indexes take short locks on a big table (`lock_timeout` 5 s); the columns are nullable without a default, so no rewrite. `chat_op_wrap_up` locks the root, then the settling reply (the order every chain op uses).

- `chat_decisions_for_item`'s readable-conversation CTE groups by `c.id` to fold the two halves; a test's `value_as` runs as `authenticated` and can't read the `test` schema, so map ids outside it.
- The worktree guard refuses shell loops/heredocs touching repo files and `psql` with computed paths: write wrapper `.sql` files in the scratchpad and run them plainly.
